Latest Netflix Engagement Reports (official, reported by Netflix)

Netflix reports twice a year. H2 2025 (released 20 Jan 2026): 96B hours, with KPop Demon Hunters at 482M views, the most-watched title ever in a six-month window. H1 2026 (released 16 Jul 2026): 97B+ hours, the highest half on record, and War Machine was the biggest title (147M views). From Q1 2027 Netflix moves to a yearly report. Netflix report ↗

Note on data

Bars for Jul 2023 – Jun 2025 are summed from the title-level data (titles with 50K+ hours). H2 2025 and H1 2026 are the totals Netflix reported. The highlight charts use the figures Netflix named in its H1 2026 report, not the full title list. Full H1 2026 file: Netflix's What We Watched xlsx on the report page.
